declare void @throw_exception()

declare i32 @__gxx_personality_v0(...)

declare ptr @__cxa_begin_catch(ptr)

declare void @__cxa_end_catch()

define void @test1() personality ptr @__gxx_personality_v0 {
entry:
  invoke void @throw_exception()
          to label %try.cont unwind label %lpad

lpad:                                             ; preds = %entry
  %0 = landingpad { ptr, i32 }
          catch ptr null
  %1 = extractvalue { ptr, i32 } %0, 0
  %2 = tail call ptr @__cxa_begin_catch(ptr %1)
  tail call void @__cxa_end_catch()
  br label %try.cont

try.cont:                                         ; preds = %lpad, %entry
  ret void
}

define <4 x i16> @wide_sext_v4i16(<4 x i16> %a, <4 x i16> %b) {
  %x = sext <4 x i16> %a to <4 x i32>
  %y = sext <4 x i16> %b to <4 x i32>
  %d = sub <4 x i32> %x, %y
  %s = ashr <4 x i32> %d, splat (i32 1)
  %r = trunc <4 x i32> %s to <4 x i16>
  ret <4 x i16> %r
}

}

define void @ashr_32bytes_wordOff(ptr %src.ptr, ptr %wordOff.ptr, ptr %dst) #0 {
  %LGV = load i32, ptr @G, align 4
  %src = load i256, ptr %src.ptr, align 1

  %bitOff = shl i256 %wordOff, 5

  store i256 %res, ptr %dst, align 1
  %G = getelementptr ptr, ptr %src.ptr, i32 %LGV
  store ptr %G, ptr poison, align 8
  ret void
}

define void @lshr_32bytes(ptr %src.ptr, ptr %bitOff.ptr, ptr %dst) #0 {

  store i256 poison, ptr %A, align 4
  %src = load i256, ptr %src.ptr, align 1
  %bitOff = load i256, ptr %bitOff.ptr, align 1
  %res = lshr i256 %src, %bitOff

  store i256 %res, ptr %dst, align 1
  store i256 %B, ptr %A, align 4
  ret void
}

  store volatile [30 x i64] %val, ptr @var, align 4
  %L = load i32, ptr %A, align 4
  switch i32 %L, label %SW_D [
    i32 659732692, label %SW_C
  ]

BB:                                               ; preds = %SW_C
  store i1 %C, ptr @G, align 1

  %C = icmp sge i1 %LGV, false
  br label %BB
}
